data.title: 久岛鸥 · 夕阳木栈桥上的皮箱回望
data.description: 金色落日将平静的海面染成绚烂赤金。鸥坐在她那只巨大的旧皮箱上，双腿悬空晃动，逆光勾勒出她头上的蝴蝶结发带，向岸边的伙伴依依挥手。
data.location: weathered rustic wooden fishing pier stretching far into sunset sea
data.action: perched sitting on massive vintage leather suitcase, waving one hand gently toward shore, bittersweet radiant smile under setting sun
data.lighting: 海面反照的浓郁晚霞金红逆光
data.promptProse: Kamome sits upon her oversized leather suitcase on a wooden ocean pier, waving goodbye with a bittersweet radiant smile in the fiery sunset glow.
data.animaCaption: Golden sunset reflections flood the calm waters around the wooden pier as she waves softly.
